scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Special Ability Pension
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant must have a valid bank account
Applicants with more than 70% disability must not be employed in government, semi‑government, corporations, or boards
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly pension of Rs. 1300 to disabled individuals (80%+ disability) from the government and state, and additional allowances for lower disability levels.
